text:
Maya (CEO): thanks folks 1 drop hiring/org questions here; we'll answer live.
Riley (Eng): are we still pausing any teams or is hiring back on across board?
Priya (Head of People): not a full pause. paused a handful of low-priority reqs; core hires (infra, runtime, platform) are greenlit.
Jonas (VP Eng): to add 1 we scaled down last quarter, now aim for a focused rebuild: net +6-8% headcount over FY, concentrated on reliability and serving.
Riley (Eng): will engineers get clarity on which teams gain hires? curious about cross-team transfers.
Priya (Head of People): managers get allocation dashboards next week. internal mobility is encouraged 1 we'll run an internal fair and a short transfer window for impacted folks.
sam_ops (Hiring Ops): process change: standard IC loops trimmed to 3 interviews + hiring manager. target time-to-offer: 28 days.
Riley (Eng): this is helpful 1 thanks for the transparency.
Maya (CEO): follow-up: updated org map will be posted Friday and leadership will host a deep-dive office hour next Wed at 10am PT. all-hands-bot: poll "Do you understand the headcount plan?" options: Yes / Somewhat / No
Priya (Head of People): i'll drop links after the thread: 1) hiring priorities doc, 2) interview templates, 3) internal mobility signup.
